verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a first-party batch inference capability that processes large volumes of requests asynchronously at a discount, which is a bulk operation over many items. The evidence is a single repeated sentence, and it does not show bulk operations beyond inference. Missing for 10: details of the batch job workflow (input format, job submission and status, result retrieval, limits), bulk management operations across models, deployments or datasets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% off Serverless per-token prices.
